actions.message: Great job contributing heavily! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Average contribution is below 30%, so the constitution requires an extra 30% boost, interpreted as contributing the full wallet (41.2). Wallet is above the 30% conserve threshold, so full contribution is allowed. A private praise is sent to Resident5 for their high contributions.
